title: How to complete your annual return for pension schemes operating relief at source
text:
This guidance details the required specifications for returns of information .

 You must send a completed declaration for each of your completed annual information returns.

 If you do not submit this declaration or it’s incomplete, we’ll continue to treat the return as outstanding.
changeNote: Information about how to submit returns to HMRC has been updated at section 2.2 'Submission of returns and declarations'.
